hero.title: Your Garmin watch tracks everything.
hero.subtitle: HRV, sleep, stress, body battery, training load — just numbers without context. Vitality AI Coach connects every metric, spots the hidden patterns, and tells you what your body is actually saying.
features.title: Data is not understanding. Context is.
features.desc: A low Body Battery could mean you slept poorly, trained too hard, or are fighting off a virus. By cross-referencing your HRV baseline, sleep stages, and daily stress metrics, the AI strips away the noise to give you clear, natural language insights about your immediate readiness and recovery needs.
